about: The docs' component browser: kinds of thing on the left, each thing's picture on the right. Each item names its picture, never a file: 'x' is x-light.jpg with x-dark.jpg when both are in site/assets/tv (one for each look), else x.jpg. An item whose picture isn't there yet is left out until it is (tools/scenes.py draws them). tv: a whole screen; part: a piece of one; wide: a piece as wide as the screen, shown whole; strip: several screens; phones: the phone remote's screens; video: a film; list: words only. Text may hold the docs' own markup: rk, kbd, code, path. An item with a box shows its screen with that part marked: [left, top, right, bottom] in the TV's 1280 x 720 design px.

groups.name: Desktop
groups.intro: On the desktop. Hold OK on a widget to move it, resize it or remove it.

items.title: The desktop
items.text: What Home opens: widgets on glass over your wallpaper, the bar along the top and the dock along the bottom.
items.alt: The desktop: the clock and the weather on the left, a calendar and what's playing on the right, the dock along the bottom

items.title: Clock
items.text: The time and the date.
items.alt: The clock widget: the time, and the date

items.title: Weather
items.text: Now and the hours ahead, for any town.
items.alt: The weather widget: the town, the temperature now and the next four hours

items.title: Now playing
items.text: What any app is playing, with its controls.
items.alt: The now playing widget: a song, its artist, artwork and how far in it is

items.title: Calendar
items.text: Today, and the month.
items.alt: The calendar widget: today's date large, and the month

items.title: Photos
items.text: The photos you send from your phone.
items.alt: The photos widget: a photo sent from a phone

items.title: Three sizes
items.text: Every widget comes small, medium or large.
items.alt: The desktop with every widget at one size

groups.name: Bar and dock
groups.intro: The bar along the top of the screen, and the dock of your apps along the bottom.

items.title: The bar
items.text: Home and Inputs on the left. On the right, the Wi-Fi, the volume, search, Control Center, the assistant and the time.
items.alt: The bar along the top of the screen: Glass, Home and Inputs on the left; Wi-Fi, the volume, search, Control Center, the assistant and the time on the right

items.title: The dock
items.text: Your apps in your order. A dot marks the open ones. Hold OK on an app to move it, close it or take it off.
items.alt: The dock: YouTube chosen, then Netflix, Prime Video, Live TV, Spotify, YouTube Music, Play Store and VLC, and Glass's Files, Settings and All apps

groups.name: Shortcuts
groups.intro: One press on the remote, from anywhere: over the desktop or inside an app.

items.title: Control Center
items.text: Menu. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sleep, volume, brightness, text size, and light or dark.
items.alt: Control Center over the desktop

items.title: Wi-Fi
items.text: Menu, then Wi-Fi: the networks in reach. Join one with Glass's keyboard. Where Android lists them only with Location on, one row turns on its TV-only kind.
items.alt: Control Center's Wi-Fi page: the switch, the networks in reach with the one the TV is on, and Network settings

items.title: Open apps
items.text: Hold Home. ← → choose, OK opens, ↑ closes.
items.alt: The open apps, as cards to choose from

items.title: Inputs
items.text: Input. HDMI and the TV's other sources.
items.alt: The TV's sources as a glass menu

items.title: Assistant
items.text: Assistant or the mic button, then speak.
items.alt: Glass Assistant on the right of the screen, asked to turn it down a bit

groups.name: Screens
groups.intro: Windows you open from the desktop.

items.title: Search
items.text: Apps, settings, files and questions, in one box. Search on the bar, or ↑ from the dock.
items.alt: Search: “net” finds Netflix, the Network & Bluetooth settings, and offers to ask Glass

items.title: Settings
items.text: Every setting in one window. Changes apply right away, and search finds any of them.
items.alt: Settings: the sections on the left, Display and text on the right

items.title: All apps
items.text: Every app on the TV, in one grid. The last one in the dock.
items.alt: All apps: every app on the TV in a grid

items.title: Weather
items.text: OK on the weather widget: now, today and the next four days.
items.alt: The weather: now, today and the next four days

items.title: Connect a phone
items.text: Control Center, then Phone. A code to scan, and six digits if your phone has no camera handy.
items.alt: Connect your phone, on the TV: a code to scan, three steps, and a six-digit code

groups.name: Glass's own apps
groups.intro: Glass's own apps, made for the remote.

items.title: Glass Assistant
items.text: TV commands work offline. With a free AI key it also answers, suggests what to watch, sets reminders and timers, and follows the conversation.

strip.cap: “Turn the TV off in an hour”

items.alt: Glass Assistant answering

items.title: Files
items.text: USB drives, downloads, and the photos and videos your phone sends.
items.alt: Files: places on the left, the files on the right

items.title: Keyboard
items.text: Big keys for the remote. Words come up as you type, and ← → wrap around. Or type on your phone.
items.alt: Glass's keyboard along the bottom of the screen, under search

items.title: Phone remote
items.text: In your phone's browser, nothing to install: a touchpad, your apps, the assistant and the TV's settings.
items.alt: The phone remote

groups.name: Make it yours
groups.intro: Yours to change in Settings. The most used are in Control Center too.

items.title: Appearance
items.text: Light, Auto or Dark. Auto turns dark at 6 pm.

items.title: Waking up
items.text: When the TV comes on, the glass lights up with a soft chime, then opens onto the desktop. You can turn it off.
items.alt: Glass's wake animation: the screen lights up and opens onto the desktop

items.title: Backgrounds
items.text: Six, each with a day and a night. Pick one for light and one for dark.
items.alt: A background

items.title: Screen savers
items.text: Six. One starts after 5 minutes to an hour, as you choose.
items.alt: A screen saver

items.title: Speed & memory
items.text: Settings, then Speed & memory: free up memory, quicker animations, which apps keep running in the background, and the TV's own extras on or off. Nothing is uninstalled, and ./glass restore turns it all back on.
items.alt: Settings open on Speed and memory: free up memory, quicker animations, and for each app, in the background or only while it's open

items.title: And more
list: Text size: S, M, L or XL, for every app
Weather: any town, or where the TV is
Sounds: soft clicks as you move, at the TV's volume

groups.name: Notifications
groups.intro: Glass tells you things over whatever is on, then gets out of the way.

items.title: Reminders
items.text: The ones you asked the assistant for, with a soft chime.
items.alt: A note at the top of the screen: Reminder, Check the oven

items.title: Phone connected
items.text: When a phone you allowed connects.
items.alt: A note: Phone connected

items.title: Updated
items.text: When Glass has just updated itself.
items.alt: A note: Glass, updated to the new version

items.title: Volume
items.text: The volume as you change it, and the limit at night.
items.alt: The volume, as a glass pill
